b: I heard about a two day reggae festival happening this weekend and checked the prices. The cheapest ticket is general admission starting at $70.00, which is “cheaper” by today’s standards. Nonetheless, it’s absolutely ridiculous compared to how prices used to be. Big name concerts and music festivals cost even more! I guess I am getting old, lol. To me, I cannot justify spending that kind of money, plus gas, food, merch, and more. And you can’t see the musicians up close, unless you are VIP. People continue to pay these prices, and the costs will keep going up. When will Americans say enough?
